_meta.method: FCA Mutuals Public Register (https://mutuals.fca.org.uk/). (1) Downloaded the register-wide CSV https://fcastoragemprprod.blob.core.windows.net/societylist/SocietyList.csv (HTTP 200, 7.3 MB, Last-Modified 2026-10-11, 32,449 rows; columns Society Number, Society Suffix, Full Registation Number, name, Registered As, dates, Act, status) and matched each published value against Full Registation Number: case-insensitive exact match; "RS0*n" -> bare post-2014-Act number n (the CSV gives those societies an empty suffix, while its own "RS" suffix marks Scottish societies); "IP0*n[R]" -> "nR" or NI "nIP". (2) For every matched number, read the public website: GET /Search/Search?SearchTerm=<value> (the search accepts names or registration numbers; results carry /Search/Society/<id> links), then the society details page /Search/Society/<id> (status, registered as, registration date/Act, address, SIC, deregistration date/method, transferred-to) and its two JSON feeds /Societies/GetNameChanges?societyId=<id> (previous names) and /Societies/GetTransfers?societyId=<id> (engagements received; TE = transfer of engagements, AM = amalgamation). ~1.2 s between requests. http/source are the details page (or, when no number matched, the website search for the published value). (3) Corroboration only: the Regulator of Social Housing "List of registered providers - 17 September 2026" (https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6aad16bcce3f006bd4346c9b/List_of_registered_providers_17_September_2026.xlsx, from https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/registered-providers-of-social-housing), matched by normalised name (register current name, previous names, and the member names) to RP code and corporate form; it carries no FCA society number, so it never decides "found". name_search_hits match the member names against current names in the CSV only.
